steps: Peel and seed the melon, then cut the flesh into rough chunks.
Place the melon chunks in a blender and blend until completely smooth.
Pour the melon purée into a medium bowl.
Add the coconut milk, chia seeds, and vanilla extract to the bowl.
Stir well and let the mixture rest for 10 minutes so the chia seeds swell.
Stir once more, then spoon the mixture into a 16-cup silicone mini-mould.
Freeze for at least 3 hours, until the bites are fully solid.
Pop the bites out of the mould and serve straight from the freezer. Store frozen for up to 4 weeks.
